display.purpose: Exhibition title and home-page narrative only.

body.purpose: Product copy, records, forms, and dense data.

shadows.name: published-medium
shadows.purpose: Drawers, dialogs, and active image surfaces.

narrative.overview: A museum working register beside an active gallery: ordered, material, and alive with evidence. Editorial invitation becomes operational precision without changing component vocabulary.

rules.name: The Published Palette Rule
rules.body: Never declare or override a CorvaUI color token in application CSS.

rules.name: The Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Shadows are reserved for active overlays and transient hierarchy.

dos: Do use concept-light and concept-dark exactly as published.
Do make mobile workflows complete and touch-safe.
donts: Don't create a generic SaaS dashboard or decorative card grid.
Don't override or recreate CorvaUI theme colors.
